title: Take that sloppers!!!
author: logical_haze
selftext:
Our game is AI 100% in and out. 

Voices of anti are becoming pitchforks of the past

replies.author: Fuzzzy420
replies.body:
Love the concept. 
My biggest problem with ki based story telling, that I am basically god. Within three prompts I am the most powerful entity in this universe. 
Helplessness is missing

replies.author: logical_haze
replies.body:
That has been a gameplay balance decision from day one.

At some point we'll let you tune your GM harshness/strictness, but it was important for me to capture the fun of my childhood days - even those nights in which we goofed around in the adventure and our GM (and good friend) would let us get away with it...

We were all there for the fun, so why stop us...

comments.author: ahrzal
comments.body: Hate to break it to you, but anti-ai is just getting started.

replies.author: logical_haze
replies.body: I've been living it for 2 years, so don't know about started. But it might become way worse before it becomes obsolete

comments.author: Apprehensive-Exam803
comments.body: This is a really unprofessional post for a developer. People are allowed to hate for any reason and it's not as though anti-ai hatred is \*completely\* unfounded. Don't be so butthurt about it and be happy someone gave you five stars.

replies.author: Fizassist1
replies.body: He's specifically calling out the people that think AI only produces slop, and then providing evidence that isnt the case and celebrating his success.  Why are you so offended?

replies.author: Apprehensive-Exam803
replies.body: "Voices of anti are becoming pitchforks of the past". That's an absurdly unprofessional comment. Also...2k reviews on this? That doesn't seem suspicious to you at all?

comments.author: golfstreamer
comments.body:
You're mind is on "antis" too much. Like gamedev is one area that the anti ai sentiment is pretty weak. 
Like millions of programmers are using AI every day, myself included.

The fact is if you make a good game people will like it. This is as true today as it was yesterday as it is tomorrow. So I really don't think your sentiment is quite right. The anti ai voices aren't "becoming the past". They already don't matter and haven't for a while now.

replies.author: Exp5000
replies.body: I'd slightly disagree. The anti AI voices still dominate any socialmedia and talking about AI openly in a non dedicated AI platform opens you up to harassment from the crazy regards. I own an AI business that builds tools for small businesses, I'd never openly share that on any social media besides LinkedIn because the Anti AI people are destructive.

replies.author: Exp5000
replies.body: With that being said. It is satisfying to know there's a lot of people I'll never have to compete for a job with. Let the anti ais fall behind and remain poor while the rest of us progress.

replies.author: golfstreamer
replies.body:
I guess my feeling is a framing issue. I just want to emphasize that people who go around harassing people for ever using AI in any situation are a small minority. The vast majority of people aren't like this. If you make a good game people will like it and buy it AI or not. 

I guess I'm just kinda tired of the whole AI war mindset whether you're pro or anti. Like why couldn't this post just be a celebration of the success your game is receiving instead of a clap back at trolls? That's kinda what I wanted to say

replies.author: Exp5000
replies.body: Ohhh I see your point. Yup totally agree. My friend's family, anyone outside of Reddit or X all are very enthusiastic about AI. It's literally just poor people that don't leave home complaining. Which explains why the art subs are full of anti AIs.

replies.author: logical_haze
replies.body:
I get that, but the specific review i shared was addressing the nay sayers

But I'm with you on love-team

replies.author: logical_haze
replies.body: That is just not true on Reddit, sorry. I've been a lot of things. Some life-saving and spot-in-heaven deserving. And still the minute I mention AI in 90% of Reddit, I git scolded out of the room
